correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed F126 local rule and all finite input words; 17 nonempty second-image subset states minimize to 13 accepting states. The prefix/suffix first-offender construction gives 29 reachable and 16 productive states. Its exact 16x16 characteristic polynomial is \(u^4(u^4+1)(u^8-2u^7+u^6-u^4-1)\). By the 16-dimensional adjugate bound, the rational numerator has degree <=17; its first 18 exact coefficients, regenerated from the matrix, establish the claimed all-length generating series. Fourteen recurrent productive states are strongly connected and have a self-loop, hence primitive, giving \(C\lambda^n\) with \(C>0\); Sturm variation (4,3,3) at 1.647072, 1.647073, 2 isolates lambda. Three locally executed Python standard-library checks pass, including independent exhaustive input-block checks through output length 14. Finite enumeration is not used to prove infinite statements. The 13-state second-image accepting automaton has exact characteristic polynomial P13 (in RESULT.md); Sturm isolates its Perron root in (1.732101,1.732102), strictly above the obstruction Perron interval (1.647072,1.647073). Consequently \(h_{\mathcal M}(Y_2)<h_{\mathrm{top}}(Y_2)\) with a certified positive gap. The finite-MME/Bernoulli-up-to-period/characteristic-measure consequence is a direct application of Wu–Zhang (2026), Theorem A and Corollary 1, not an independently proved classification.

An unindexed earlier equivalent computation remains a stated residual priority risk. We claim only the exact Rule 126 series, its rate, and the strictly evaluated entropy inequality as new; their general measure conclusion is cited as a known consequence.
residual_risks: A full-pixel rendering of the 2015 Figure 7 was not separately read; its caption and technical construction were read, and an unindexed derivation of the antidictionary series might exist.

Published process graphs determine the time-two output language in principle; some readers may regard an explicit invariant calculated from that known presentation as a derivative refinement rather than a new dynamical theorem.
Historical novelty was checked against accessible published material and relevant records, not independently certified by a specialist.

Finiteness of ergodic maximal-entropy measures is also a classical property of sofic systems; the new contribution is not that abstract corollary, but its explicit entropy-gap hypothesis and exact Rule 126 computations.

value.rationale: Minimal forbidden words are a natural measure of sofic-language obstruction complexity. Rule 126 is an independently motivated extremizer: its first time-one/time-two discrepancy appears only at output length 12. The new exact rational series and primitive Perron growth prove that the image switches from a single-forbidden-word SFT at time one to a proper sofic time-two image with exponentially many minimal obstructions. This is a motivated exact natural invariant, not a generic arbitrary finite slice, textbook restatement, or recomputation of the earlier shortest-witness table; it can guide studies of how cellular automaton image constraints proliferate. The November 2026 Wu–Zhang theorem makes the precise \(h_{\mathcal M}\) versus \(h_{\mathrm{top}}\) comparison especially motivated: our separately evaluated Perron roots exhibit strict inequality by about 0.0503357791 nats per site and provide a natural explicit cellular-automaton example satisfying its hypothesis.
